releases.name: duo-editor
releases.description: The Duo editor on iPhone Duo: the claim on the left page and question cards on the right, built on Xcode Cloud and shipped to TestFlight testers.

clusters.title: iPhone Duo editor: one claim, one refutation, on TestFlight
clusters.description: The native slices of CIT-439: the iOS project, the build-time JSON bundle, the Xcode Cloud workflows, the supervisor reading their results, and the SwiftUI app. Review findings and verification of the iOS project (CIT-521, CIT-522, CIT-525, CIT-526) are handled as follow-ups; running the tests in Xcode needs the maintainer on a Mac.
